apps.title: Modelling Playground
apps.summary: Change the models themselves: drive a population into chaos, click a phase plane to release predators and prey, and simulate colonies going extinct.

apps.title: Front Office Workbench
apps.summary: A front office in your browser: grade any MLB regular against his position, value a contract with an aging curve, see what wins are worth at the gate, and price every seat in a simulated ballpark.
